data.title: 德克萨斯 · 巧克力香气里的荒野旧梦

data.description: 叙拉古郊外安全屋汽车旅馆，推拉窗外是荒芜公路与远山连绵的夜色。坐在皮箱上，嘴里咬着半根细长巧克力棒，狼耳微动，单手插在睡袍口袋里，黑发垂肩，琥珀色眼眸带着叙拉古旧日风尘的沉静与对你的无声依赖。 她微微抬眸轻语——“……罗德岛的生活很平静，这样就好。博士……要分你半根巧克力吗？”
data.promptProse: Sitting calmly upon a leather courier case in a quiet roadside motel room, Texas bites on a slender chocolate pocky stick. A dim wall lamp casts a warm amber glow over her relaxed profile, while the dark wilderness highway stretches outside the sliding window.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on a courier case biting a chocolate pocky stick, she gazes calmly beside the quiet motel window.
